question: The Sirpur National Dance and Music Festival is organised every year in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sirpur National Dance and Music Festival is an annual cultural event held in the town of Sirpur in Chhattisgarh.**
 
• The festival celebrates the rich cultural heritage of India and showcases various traditiona**l dance and music forms**.
 
• **It is organized by the Chhattisgarh Tourism Board and attracts artists and performers from all over the country.**
 
• **The festival also includes workshops, seminars, and exhibitions on various art forms.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand **has a rich cultural heritage and is known for its tribal art and music. 

 
 
• **Famous festivals are Sarhul, Karam, Jawa, Tusu Parab or Makar, Hal Punhya, and Bhagta Parab.**
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is known for its classical music and dance forms such as Kathak and Hindustani classical music.
 
 
• **Famous festivals are Buddha Purnima, Ganga Dussehra, Makar Sankranti, Ayudha Pooja, and Janmashtami.**
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is known for its folk music and dance forms such as** Gond and Bhil.**
 
 
• **Famous festivals are Lokrang Festival, Akhil Bhartiya Kalidas Samaroh, Khajuraho Festival, Bhagoria Haat Festival and Holi.**
